inlines.v: TOR'PENT, adjective [Latin torpens, torpeo.] Benumbed; torpid; having no motion or activity; incapable of motion. A frail and torpent memory. TOR'PENT, noun In medicine, that which diminishes the exertion of the irritative motions.
